rules: Exactly one feature may be in_progress at a time.
A feature moves to done only when every item in its doneCriteria has recorded evidence in progress.md.
If work reveals a needed change outside the active feature's scope, add a new feature entry with status backlog instead of doing it now.

features.title: Grade 6 topics and generators
doneCriteria: Every grade 6 topic resolves to a registered generator
generators.test.ts and answers.test.ts pass at all three levels

features.title: Printable A4 sheet and answer key
doneCriteria: Answer key starts on its own printed page and problems do not split across pages

features.title: Mistake capture and spaced repetition
features.scope: lib/progress/*, lib/mixed.ts, app/review/[grade], app/mivdak/[grade], plus UI entry points in components/. No changes to generator signatures.
constraints: localStorage only — no auth, no backend, no database
Scheduling is keyed by skill (topicId + level); attempts also record (seed, count, wrong indexes). Never store generated problem text as the source of truth, regenerate it from the seed
Review state must never influence which problems a sheet renders — the determinism invariant in AGENTS.md still holds
Reads of localStorage must be client-side only; the sheet page is a server component and must stay renderable without it
Must degrade to a working worksheet when localStorage is unavailable or cleared
decisions: A review sheet gets its own seed (the date) and asks the same problem shapes with new numbers — practising the method, not the memory of one answer. Deliberately NOT a replay of the original seed.
Leitner boxes over 1/3/7/14/30 day intervals: accuracy >= 0.8 promotes, >= 0.5 holds, below 0.5 resets to box 0.
doneCriteria: Marking a problem wrong persists and survives a reload
A review sheet draws the due skills and interleaves them, proven by a test over the full mark-to-review loop
Print preview of a review sheet checked at A4
Marking verified in a real browser: panel appears, save persists across reload, no hydration error
